additional_info.subject: After reboot 16/1 back online and charging sessions in greenflux !
RE: ID0472271-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001199] Status disabled / offline in Greenflux CRM:03056000954
additional_info.body:
Dear Chloe,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0472271.
The ticket was opened for charger
MP/PD 170001199,
where outlet 2 was detected as out of order and reboots triggered by Sifinity were not reaching the charger.
I had a look at the events on 2026-01-13, and that is what I found:
The charger went sporadically 12 times offline with Greenflux, but never for more than 5 seconds. That is why you might have noticed the charger offline in Greenflux. That is due to a loss of connection from the network provider.
The outlet 2 was detected as outoforder due to an internal FW issue in our SECC. The outlet was not in charge, but internally the SECC was eventually setting the outlet as in use with error, hence outoforder. Our R&D department is working to fix this wrong handling of the outlet form the SECC, and a fix is forecasted to be included in the upcoming FW
v
9.0.X
(expected date of release: CW10)
I saw in the logs #3 attempts of soft reboot, one on 13.01.2026, one on 14.01.2026, one on 15.01.2026. Unfortunately, if the charger is internally detecting that one outlet is in use (due to the SECC error the session on outlet 2 was not properly closed, hence it was as in use), the soft reboot is unable to reboot the charger if an outlet is in use. In this case, I would recommend for the next times to trigger a Hard reboot. With a Hard reboot, the charger performs different internal checks, and if there is no active transfer of current, the charger reboots, even if the outlet is detected as in use (for example, with a vehicle connected at the end of a session).
In conclusion, the error will be fixed within the new FW v9.0.X by CW 10, and if the issue happens again, I would recommend to trigger via Sifinity a Hard reboot rather than a Soft reboot. The reboot will restore the charger.
Since no further action is required form service side, and a fix is already in the roadmap and timeline communicated, I will proceed to close the ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
